Remark
[Covariant formula for the adjoint of $d$] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0297 1. Section A.3\group first-order-differential-operators-on-forms

By integration by parts, \[ (\delta \eta )(X_1,\ldots ,X_p) = - \sum _{i=1}^n (\nabla \eta )(e_i,e_i,X_1,\ldots ,X_p), \] where $\{ e_i\} _{i=1}^n$ is a local orthonormal frame field. This formula also serves to define $\delta $ when $\mathcal M^n$ is not compact.
